scope: DFW suburbs (Collin, Denton, Rockwall, Kaufman, Ellis, Johnson counties)

records.name: North Texas Food Bank - Find Food
records.description_en: The food bank sends food to hundreds of partner pantries and mobile food events. It also helps people apply for SNAP food benefits.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone who needs food in the food bank's service area can use its pantry finder. Each pantry sets its own rules.
records.how_to_apply: Use the Find a Food Pantry tool on the website to find a pantry or mobile distribution near you. Call the SNAP line for help applying for food benefits.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8:30 a.m.-4:30 p.m.; Sat 8:30 a.m.-3:30 p.m. (campus hours)
records.notes: Service area listed: Dallas, Collin, Fannin, Rockwall, Hunt, Grayson, Kaufman, Ellis, Navarro, Lamar, Delta, Hopkins. Denton is no longer in NTFB's area (see Tarrant Area Food Bank). SNAP help line: (214) 269-0906.

records.name: Tarrant Area Food Bank - Find Local Food (TAFB North)
records.description_en: The food bank supplies local food pantries across North Texas. Its online map helps you find a pantry near you, and staff can help you apply for SNAP.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For anyone who needs food. Each partner pantry sets its own rules and hours.
records.how_to_apply: Search the Find Food map on the website, then call the pantry before you go to confirm days and hours.
records.notes: TAFB North is in Denton and TAFB West is in Weatherford. Main office: 2600 Cullen Street, Fort Worth. The page did not list counties; Denton/Johnson coverage is inferred from office locations and from local pantries (for example CCA in Lewisville) that partner with TAFB. Confirm locally.

records.name: Minnie's Food Pantry Drive-Thru
records.description_en: A free drive-thru food pantry in Plano. It also has walk-up service for people who are homeless and a free clothing and household boutique.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone can use the drive-thru. There is no income test and no interview. The boutique is for low-income families and needs an intake appointment.
records.how_to_apply: Drive up during open hours. People experiencing homelessness can walk up once a week.
records.notes: Boutique is at 651 18th Street.

records.name: Frisco Family Services Market
records.description_en: A free grocery-store style food market with meat, dairy, fresh produce, and hygiene items. It also offers online order pickup and home delivery for people who cannot get there.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who live in Frisco or inside Frisco ISD and have a documented crisis.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: City of Frisco or Frisco ISD resident

documents_needed: Photo ID for each applicant
Current lease or housing agreement
ID for all household members (birth certificate, passport, school ID, or Social Security card)
Household bills
Proof of your crisis (for example doctor letter or medical bills)
Proof of all income (for example 1 month of pay stubs or benefit letters)
records.how_to_apply: Go to the office at 9111 Dogwood St. to fill out an application, or download it ahead of time. Bring it with your documents to set up a meeting with a case manager.
records.notes: Spanish info by phone at 972-335-9495. Market Express (online order, curbside pickup) and Mobile Market (home delivery) are available.

records.name: The Samaritan Inn Food Pantry
records.description_en: A grocery-store style food pantry in McKinney, plus Saturday drive-through mobile food events with staples, meat, and dairy.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the pantry's service area of north and east Collin County towns, including McKinney, Anna, Celina, Melissa, Princeton, Prosper, and others.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Live in a listed Collin County service-area town (e.g., McKinney, Anna, Celina, Princeton, Prosper)

documents_needed: Photo ID
Proof of current address (lease or utility bill; a phone photo is OK; not needed if homeless)
records.how_to_apply: New clients can apply in person during pantry hours, Tuesday through Friday.
records.notes: Full town list: Anna, Altoga, Blue Ridge, Celina, Copeville, Farmersville, Josephine, Lavon, Lowry Crossing, McKinney, Melissa, Nevada, New Hope, Princeton, Prosper, Van Alstyne, Westminster, Weston. Mobile distributions at First United Methodist (2nd and 4th Sat) and First Christian Church McKinney (1st Sat).

records.name: CCA Food Market and Family Services
records.description_en: A choice food market with groceries, milk, meat, produce, hygiene items, and diapers. CCA also offers limited utility help, career coaching, and counseling.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who live in Denton County, Coppell ISD, or Frisco ISD and meet CCA's income rules. Emergency food is given the same day to eligible residents.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Denton County, Coppell ISD, or Frisco ISD resident

documents_needed: Photo ID for all adults
ID for all children (birth certificate or Social Security card)
Proof of all adult income for the last month
Copy of lease
Current utility bill or mail showing address
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Family Services office in Lewisville to sign up. Financial help requires joining a CCA program and filling out the online request form; walk-in requests for money are not accepted.
records.hours: Family Services: Mon-Fri 9-11 a.m. and Mon-Thu 1-3 p.m.
records.notes: CCA no longer gives general rent or mortgage help. Weekly market visits require attending one class, workshop, or approved activity.

records.name: Denton Community Food Center
records.description_en: An independent nonprofit food pantry in Denton that gives food to families and people facing hunger.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Denton-area families and individuals who need food. Appointments are required.
records.how_to_apply: Make an appointment, then park in the marked area and come inside for food. For after-hours emergency help, dial 2-1-1.
records.hours: Mon and Wed 10:30 a.m.-12:15 p.m. by appointment only; select Saturdays 9:30-11:00 a.m. by appointment
records.notes: The website did not list a direct phone number; it points to 2-1-1 for after-hours emergencies. Saturday dates change; check the website.

records.name: Our Daily Bread Day Shelter and Meals
records.description_en: A day shelter in Denton that serves free lunch and dinner every day. It also offers showers, clothing and prescription vouchers, mail service, a phone and computer lab, and help finding housing.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people experiencing homelessness or hunger in Denton County.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during day shelter hours. Staff can do a Coordinated Entry housing assessment.
records.hours: Day shelter daily 10 a.m.-7 p.m.; lunch daily 11:30 a.m.-1 p.m.; dinner daily 5:30-6:30 p.m.
records.notes: Also runs a Housing Focused Shelter Program and an inclement weather shelter.

records.name: Span Meals on Wheels of Denton County
records.description_en: Delivers hot, healthy meals to homebound seniors, disabled veterans, and people with disabilities. It also helps seniors get pet food.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For homebound seniors, disabled veterans, and people with disabilities in Denton County.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the Meals Client Application on the Span website or call the office.

records.name: The Samaritan Inn Housing Program (Shelter)
records.description_en: A shelter and housing program in McKinney for men, women, and families who are homeless. Residents get case management, counseling, job help, and money classes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For homeless adults and families who can pass a drug test, pass a background check, and work full-time (part-time if disabled).
documents_needed: Government-issued ID
Social Security cards for adults and children
Birth certificates for children
records.how_to_apply: Come to an intake interview, first come first served, on Tuesday, Thursday, or Sunday from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m.
records.hours: Intake interviews Tue, Thu, Sun 8:00 a.m.-1:00 p.m.
records.notes: Must be drug- and alcohol-free for 30 days before intake. People with violent offenses may not be admitted (older than 10 years reviewed case by case). Limited kennel space for dogs; call ahead.

records.name: The Samaritan Inn Emergency Rent and Utility Assistance
records.description_en: Limited help paying the current month's rent for Collin County residents, and help with Atmos, NRG-affiliate, and TXU utility bills.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Collin County residents facing hardship. Money is limited and help is not guaranteed.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Samaritan Inn Emergency Services page. Email Assistance@saminn.org with questions.
records.notes: As of this check, the rent assistance application was CLOSED; utility assistance application was open. Only current-month rent is covered.

records.name: Frisco Family Services Emergency Financial Assistance
records.description_en: Helps families stay in their homes and keep utilities on. Payments go straight to landlords, utility companies, and others. Can also help with prescriptions.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who live in the city of Frisco or Frisco ISD and have a documented crisis like job loss, medical bills, death, or divorce.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: City of Frisco or Frisco ISD resident

documents_needed: Photo ID for each applicant
Current lease or housing agreement
ID for all household members
Copies of all household bills
Proof of your crisis
Proof of all income (last 30 days)
records.how_to_apply: Pick up or download an application, then bring it with your documents to the office to schedule a case manager appointment.
records.notes: A disconnect notice alone is not accepted as a billing statement. People outside Frisco are told to dial 2-1-1.

records.name: Plano Housing Authority - Housing Choice Voucher and Public Housing
records.description_en: Runs Housing Choice Vouchers (Section 8), VASH vouchers for veterans, and low-rent public housing in Plano. People join a waiting list.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households. Low-rent public housing only has 3- and 4-bedroom homes, so it is for households of 5 or more.
records.how_to_apply: Check the Waiting Lists tab on the website to see when applications open. Update your application every Jan 15-Feb 15 and Jul 15-Aug 15 or you will be dropped.
records.hours: Mon-Thu 8:00 a.m.-6:30 p.m.; Fri closed (lobby closed to public; appointments only)
records.notes: TDD/TTY: 800-545-1833. Waitlist info is not given by phone.

records.name: McKinney Housing Authority
records.description_en: The public housing agency for McKinney. It offers affordable housing for low-income residents.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households. Contact the office for current programs and waitlist status.
records.how_to_apply: Call or email the office to ask about open waiting lists.
records.notes: Email: info@mckinneyha.org. Program details were not listed on the pages reviewed.

records.name: Denton County Friends of the Family - Emergency Shelter and Crisis Line
records.organization: Denton County Friends of the Family
records.description_en: Free help for survivors of domestic violence, rape, and sexual abuse. Services include emergency shelter, transitional housing, counseling, and legal advocacy.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people affected by domestic violence, sexual assault, or abuse in Denton County.
records.how_to_apply: Call or text the 24-hour crisis line. All clients do an intake to see what help they need. In an emergency, call 9-1-1.
records.notes: Address is the Denton outreach office; shelter location is confidential.

records.name: Hope's Door New Beginning Center - Shelter and Hotline
records.description_en: Free and private help for survivors of domestic abuse and their children, including emergency shelter, counseling, legal help, and safety planning.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For survivors of intimate partner or family violence in North Texas, including Collin County.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24-hour hotline any day. Outreach services are also offered at the Plano office.
records.hours: Hotline and shelters 24 hours a day, every day
records.notes: Plano address is the outreach office and resale store (972-769-0610). Also has a Garland outreach office. Coverage beyond Collin County not confirmed.

records.name: Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP) - Texoma Council of Governments
records.organization: Texoma Council of Governments (TCOG) Energy Services
records.description_en: Helps low-income households pay electric, gas, and propane bills. This is the local CEAP provider for Collin, Denton, and Rockwall counties.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For households at or below 150% of the federal poverty level living in Collin, Cooke, Denton, Fannin, Grayson, Hunt, or Rockwall County.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Collin, Denton, or Rockwall County resident (also Cooke, Fannin, Grayson, Hunt)

documents_needed: Proof of income for all household members 18+ for the last 30 days
All pages of current electric, gas, or propane bills
Proof of citizenship for all household members (passport or birth certificate)
Photo ID for adults 18+
Completed 2026 application packet
records.how_to_apply: Download the 2026 application packet. Mail or drop it off at 1117 Gallagher Dr., Suite 200, Sherman, TX 75090, or drop it off in Plano at 900 East Park Blvd., Suite 155. Applications are not accepted by email, online, or fax.
records.notes: Applications go on a wait list; incomplete applications are delayed. Energy Services ext. 3541. Income table effective Jan 26, 2026 (e.g., 150% FPL = $49,500 for a family of 4).

records.name: Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP) - Texas Neighborhood Services
records.description_en: Helps low-income households pay electric, gas, and propane bills. This is the local CEAP provider for Johnson County.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households in Erath, Hood, Johnson, Palo Pinto, Parker, Somervell, or Wise County.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Johnson County resident (also Erath, Hood, Palo Pinto, Parker, Somervell, Wise)

documents_needed: Signed SAVE form
Housing and Utility Supplement form
Birth certificate, passport, or immigration document for each household member
Photo ID for adults 18+
Proof of income for last 30 days (or Declaration of Income form)
Most recent utility bill
Benefit letters (Social Security, SSI, VA, child support, etc.) if any
Two IDs for children (e.g., school records, Social Security card)
records.how_to_apply: Apply 24/7 through the online Utility Assistance Portal and upload your documents. You can also email the application to application@txns.org, mail it, or drop it in the lock box at the Weatherford office.
records.hours: Mon-Thu 9:00 a.m.-3:00 p.m. (Fridays no clients seen)
records.notes: Phone is 1-817-598-5700 ext 1010. TNS also lists rental and short-term financial assistance programs.

records.name: Energy Assistance (CEAP) - Economic Opportunity Advancement Corporation
records.description_en: Short-term help with electric and gas bills, plus home weatherization. This is the CEAP provider for Ellis County.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For households at or below 150% of the federal poverty guidelines in McLennan, Bosque, Freestone, Limestone, Hill, Falls, Ellis, or Navarro County.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Ellis County resident (or other EOAC counties)

documents_needed: Completed application for the current program year
Citizenship or immigration papers for all household members
Photo ID for each household member 18+
Proof of income for the past 30 days for all adults 18+
Current electric and gas bills (front and back)
records.how_to_apply: Download the application and mail, fax, or drop it off. Applications are not accepted by email.
records.notes: Office is in Waco. Kaufman County's CEAP provider could not be confirmed this session; refer Kaufman residents to 2-1-1 or TDHCA's Help for Texans finder.

records.name: Community Services Block Grant Case Management (CSBG)
records.description_en: Case management to help low-income families become self-sufficient. It can include rent help, job and school support, money coaching, and transportation resources.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of CSI's 10-county area, including Collin, Denton, Ellis, Kaufman, and Rockwall, who are at or below 125% of the federal poverty level.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Anderson, Collin, Denton, Ellis, Henderson, Hunt, Kaufman, Navarro, Rockwall, or Van Zandt County

documents_needed: Photo ID
Social Security card
Pay stubs for the last 30 days
Current-year benefit letters (SSI, SSDI, pension, unemployment, workers' comp)
records.how_to_apply: Download the 2026 application and turn it in with all documents. Call 903-872-2401 to make an appointment at the Corsicana main office or Denton satellite office.
records.notes: IMPORTANT: site says 2026 applications will be accepted ONLY on October 5, 2026, on the updated form; incomplete applications are not processed. Help is not guaranteed. Toll-free 1-800-831-9929. CSI does not run utility assistance; it refers to TCOG, EOAC, and GETCAP.

records.name: McKinney Workforce Center
records.organization: Workforce Solutions for North Central Texas
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, job training, and career services. Staff can also connect you to child care scholarships.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in Collin County.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center in person or contact staff by phone, email, or online.

records.name: Plano Workforce Center
records.organization: Workforce Solutions for North Central Texas
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, job training, and career services. Staff can also connect you to child care scholarships.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in Collin County.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center in person or contact staff by phone, email, or online.

records.name: Denton Workforce Center
records.organization: Workforce Solutions for North Central Texas
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, job training, and career services. Staff can also connect you to child care scholarships.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in Denton County.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center in person or contact staff by phone, email, or online.
records.notes: Terrell center serves Kaufman and Rockwall; Waxahachie also serves Navarro; Denton also serves Wise.

records.name: Waxahachie Workforce Center
records.organization: Workforce Solutions for North Central Texas
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, job training, and career services. Staff can also connect you to child care scholarships.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in Ellis County.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center in person or contact staff by phone, email, or online.
records.notes: Terrell center serves Kaufman and Rockwall; Waxahachie also serves Navarro; Denton also serves Wise.

records.name: Cleburne Workforce Center
records.organization: Workforce Solutions for North Central Texas
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, job training, and career services. Staff can also connect you to child care scholarships.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in Johnson County.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center in person or contact staff by phone, email, or online.

records.name: Terrell Workforce Center
records.organization: Workforce Solutions for North Central Texas
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, job training, and career services. Staff can also connect you to child care scholarships.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in Kaufman and Rockwall County.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center in person or contact staff by phone, email, or online.
records.notes: Terrell center serves Kaufman and Rockwall; Waxahachie also serves Navarro; Denton also serves Wise.

records.name: Child Care Services Scholarships
records.organization: Workforce Solutions for North Central Texas
records.description_en: Helps low-income families pay for child care so parents can work, look for work, or go to school or job training.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For families in the 14-county area (including Collin, Denton, Ellis, Johnson, Kaufman, Rockwall) with a child age 12 or under, or through 18 with a documented disability. Parents must work or be in school/training at least 25 hours a week (50 for two parents), or be looking for work. Families experiencing homelessness may qualify.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Collin, Denton, Ellis, Erath, Hood, Hunt, Johnson, Kaufman, Navarro, Palo Pinto, Parker, Rockwall, Somervell, or Wise County

documents_needed: Proof of county residency
Proof of U.S. citizenship or legal immigration status for each child (birth certificate, I-551, etc.)
Pay stubs for the last 13 weeks for all working household members
School/training information for adults (school name, hours enrolled, transcript)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online for a Child Care Scholarship through the Workforce Solutions for North Central Texas website.
records.notes: Family assets must not exceed $1 million. Full-time college-only parents limited to 60 months total.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - McKinney Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people, including evictions and landlord problems, family law, public benefits, and consumer issues.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people with a civil (not criminal) legal problem who live in or have a case in a county served. You likely qualify if you get SNAP, Medicaid, SSI, WIC, or live in public housing.
records.how_to_apply: Call the local office during intake hours, call the Legal Aid Line at 888-529-5277, or apply online. Call the local office if you have a court deadline or were served with a lawsuit.
records.notes: Also serves Fannin, Grayson, Hunt. Free walk-in evening clinics in Allen and Plano (monthly). Landlord-tenant line: 855-548-8457.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - Denton Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people, including evictions and landlord problems, family law, public benefits, and consumer issues.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people with a civil (not criminal) legal problem who live in or have a case in a county served. You likely qualify if you get SNAP, Medicaid, SSI, WIC, or live in public housing.
records.how_to_apply: Call the local office during intake hours, call the Legal Aid Line at 888-529-5277, or apply online. Call the local office if you have a court deadline or were served with a lawsuit.
records.notes: Also serves Cooke, Jack, Montague, Wise. Monthly clinic at CCA in Lewisville. Landlord-tenant line: 855-548-8457.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - Waxahachie Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people, including evictions and landlord problems, family law, public benefits, and consumer issues.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people with a civil (not criminal) legal problem who live in or have a case in a county served. You likely qualify if you get SNAP, Medicaid, SSI, WIC, or live in public housing.
records.how_to_apply: Call the local office during intake hours, call the Legal Aid Line at 888-529-5277, or apply online. Call the local office if you have a court deadline or were served with a lawsuit.
records.notes: Landlord-tenant line: 855-548-8457.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - Weatherford Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people, including evictions and landlord problems, family law, public benefits, and consumer issues.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people with a civil (not criminal) legal problem who live in or have a case in a county served. You likely qualify if you get SNAP, Medicaid, SSI, WIC, or live in public housing.
records.how_to_apply: Call the local office during intake hours, call the Legal Aid Line at 888-529-5277, or apply online. Call the local office if you have a court deadline or were served with a lawsuit.
records.notes: Also serves Erath, Hood, Palo Pinto, Parker, Somervell. Landlord-tenant line: 855-548-8457.

records.name: DCTA Reduced Fare Program
records.description_en: Lower fares on DCTA buses, the A-train, and shared rides for seniors, people with disabilities, Medicare cardholders, and students. Children 5 and under ride free.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For seniors 65+, people with disabilities, Medicare cardholders, and students ages 6 to 18 with a student ID.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the DCTA Reduced Fare application (English, Spanish, or Hakha Chin) to get a Reduced Fare Eligible badge. Then buy reduced fare passes.
records.notes: The badge is not a pass by itself; you still need a paid fare. DCTA Access paratransit serves Denton, Lewisville, and Highland Village.

records.name: Collin County Rides (Senior and Disabled Mobility)
records.description_en: Shared rides by appointment in minivans, including wheelchair-accessible vans, for trips within Collin County such as medical appointments.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For permanent residents of Allen or Fairview who are 65 or older or have a qualifying disability.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online or download the application form. Once approved, book rides in the RideDCTA app or by phone at least one day ahead.
records.hours: Service Mon-Fri 6:00 a.m.-6:00 p.m.; phone reservations Mon-Fri 8 a.m.-5 p.m., Sat 8 a.m.-3:45 p.m.
records.notes: Riders qualify by age 65+ OR a qualifying disability. Trips must start or end in Allen or Fairview and stay within Collin County. Pay by credit/debit card only (no cash). No same-day rides.

records.name: DART Reduced Fare GoPass Tap Card
records.description_en: A 50% discount on DART buses, trains, and TRE. DART serves Plano in Collin County.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For veterans, seniors 65+, people with disabilities, children 5-14, high school and college students, and people who qualify based on income.
records.how_to_apply: Apply or renew online. You will need to verify your identity and eligibility, and the card is mailed to you.
records.notes: DART's service area includes Plano (and Dallas County cities), confirmed on dart.org About DART page. Children under 5 ride free with a paying adult (up to two). Customer service 5 a.m.-midnight daily.

records.name: STAR Transit Dial-a-Ride (Reduced Fares for Seniors, Veterans, Disabled)
records.description_en: Public curb-to-curb bus rides to work, school, medical visits, shopping, and more in Kaufman and Rockwall counties. Seniors, veterans, and riders with disabilities pay half price.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in the service area can ride. Reduced fares are for people 60+, veterans, and people with disabilities. Children 12 and under ride free.
records.how_to_apply: Call at least 1 business day (up to 2 weeks) ahead to book a ride. Call the office to verify reduced fare eligibility.
records.hours: Rides most areas Mon-Fri 6 a.m.-6 p.m.; scheduling Mon-Fri 8 a.m.-4 p.m.
records.notes: Also serves Mesquite, Balch Springs, Seagoville, DeSoto, Cedar Hill, Duncanville, Hutchins, Lancaster, Wilmer. Medicaid rides are booked through your health plan. Free Client Advocates can ride along to medical appointments.

records.name: Community Transit Service (CTS)
records.description_en: Curb-to-curb public bus rides from your home, job, or doctor's office, with wheelchair-accessible buses.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the general public. Trips must start in Ellis or Navarro County. No special requirements.
records.how_to_apply: Call 1-800-834-1924 to schedule a ride. Buy a bus pass from your driver.
records.notes: Children can ride with a parent.

records.name: Span Transportation
records.description_en: Rides for people with special needs, including people who use wheelchairs or other mobility devices, in Denton County.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For mobility-impaired people and people with special needs in Denton County.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the Rider Application on the Span website, or call the transportation line.
records.notes: Fare/cost not stated on the page reviewed.

records.name: LifePath Systems (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: The public mental health and disability services center for Collin County. It offers crisis help, counseling, adult and youth services, and early childhood intervention.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Collin County residents with mental health needs, intellectual or developmental disabilities, or young children with delays.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24/7 crisis line anytime, or call the McKinney outpatient clinic to get services.
records.notes: 24/7 crisis line: 1-877-422-5939. Plano clinic: 7308 Alma Dr. IDD office: (972) 727-9133. Admin: (972) 562-0190.

records.name: Denton County MHMR Center (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: The public mental health and intellectual and developmental disability services center for Denton County, with a crisis line.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Denton County residents needing mental health, crisis, or IDD services.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main line to start services. In a crisis, call the crisis line or 988.

records.name: Lakes Regional Community Center - Rockwall and Kaufman Clinics
records.description_en: Mental health, substance use, and developmental disability services with clinics in Rockwall and Terrell.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of Rockwall and Kaufman counties who need mental health, substance use, or IDD services.
records.how_to_apply: Call the local clinic. For a mental health crisis in Kaufman or Rockwall County, call the NTBHA crisis hotline 866-260-8000.
records.notes: Terrell (Kaufman County) MH clinic: 972-524-4159. Administration in Terrell: 202 Lee Street, 972-388-2000. Non-emergency toll-free 877-505-2537.

records.name: Pecan Valley Centers - Cleburne Clinic
records.organization: Pecan Valley Centers for Behavioral & Developmental Healthcare
records.description_en: Outpatient mental health care for adults, children, and teens in Johnson County, plus IDD services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Johnson County residents who need mental health or developmental disability services.
records.how_to_apply: Call the crisis and intake line to be screened, or call the Cleburne clinic.
records.hours: Late hours until 7 p.m. every Tuesday
records.notes: Mental health crisis hotline and intake: 1-800-772-5987. IDD intake: 1-866-948-7198. Cleburne IDD office: 910 Granbury St., 817-766-5331.

records.name: Health Services of North Texas (Community Health Center)
records.description_en: A nonprofit community health center with clinics in Denton, Plano, and Wylie. It takes Medicaid, CHIP, Medicare, and insurance, and has a sliding fee for people without insurance.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone. Uninsured patients can pay on a sliding scale based on income and family size.
records.how_to_apply: Call to book an appointment or book online.
records.notes: Denton sites: 4304 and 4308 Mesa Dr; 3537 S I-35 E Ste 210; 306 N Loop 288 Ste 200. Wylie Children's clinic: 303 S Hwy 78 Ste 106, (972) 801-9689. HRSA-supported.

records.name: Denton County Public Health WIC
records.description_en: Free healthy foods, nutrition classes, and breastfeeding help for pregnant women, new mothers, and young children. WIC families can also get a $30 farmers market voucher.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant women, new mothers, and young children who meet WIC income rules.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the county WIC page, or visit a WIC office in Denton, Lewisville, or Carrollton.
records.notes: Phone listed is the Denton County Public Health directory number shown on the WIC page. Other offices: 190 N Valley Pkwy, Lewisville 75067; 3024 E Hebron Pkwy, Carrollton 75010 (WIC only). Farmers market info in English and Spanish.

records.name: Kaufman County Indigent Health Care Program
records.description_en: Pays for basic health care like doctor visits, hospital care, lab work, and prescriptions for very low-income Kaufman County residents.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Kaufman County residents who do not qualify for other state or federal health programs, with monthly net income at or below 21% of the federal poverty guidelines and limited resources.
records.how_to_apply: Download the application in English or Spanish from the county website and turn it in to the Courthouse Annex, or email indigenthealth@kaufmancounty.net.
records.notes: Resources may not exceed $2,000 ($3,000 if an aged or disabled relative lives in the home). Must have a medical need.

records.name: Collin County Veteran Services
records.description_en: Free help for veterans and their families applying for VA and state benefits, including disability claims, pensions, and survivor benefits.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces and their dependents.
records.how_to_apply: Call or email to schedule an appointment.
records.notes: Office closed 9/28/2026-10/02/2026 for training; during closure call Texas Veterans Commission (800) 252-8387. Email veteranservices@collincountytx.gov.
